All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AccessControl
Role checks for the service layer (brief: role-based access control at the API layer, not only in the UI).
Admin
Admin account: approves listings and manages users, listings and reports.
AdminDashboardController
Admin dashboard controller: builds the listing review, users, listings, deals, ratings, notifications and profile screens in one content pane.
AdminFilters
Filter predicates for the admin deals table and review list (SRS UC-3.5, UC-3.6).
AdminLoginController
Handles the admin login form and opens the admin dashboard.
AdminService
Admin-only actions.
AdminService.AccountActivity
What the soft-delete warning dialog shows before the admin confirms (SRS UC-3.3).
AuditEntry
One immutable line of the admin audit log (SRS UC-3.3 S1): who, when, what, to what.
AuditStore
Append-only record of admin actions (SRS UC-3.3 S1, UC-3.7).
BorrowRequest
A request to borrow a Lend listing for a period.
Buyer
Buyer account: browses listings and makes offers, borrow requests and claims.
BuyerDashboardController
Buyer dashboard controller: builds the browse, deals, history, favourites, notifications and profile screens in one content pane.
BuyerLoginController
Handles the buyer login form and opens the buyer dashboard.
BuyerRegisterController
Handles the buyer registration form, including the UC-1.1 password rules.
Category
The fourteen SRS categories used to group and filter listings (SRS Appendix A).
ChatService
The public seam for chat.
ChatStore
Chat threads and their retained message history, one thread per (Buyer, Listing) pair.
ChatThread
The private conversation about one Listing between that Listing's Buyer and Seller (GLOSSARY).
ChatViewBuilder
Builds the one chat view shared by the buyer and seller portals, so both sides see the same conversation record, the same offers-closed banner and the same send behaviour.
Claim
A claim on a Giveaway listing.
Condition
The item condition choices offered on a listing (SRS Appendix A).
Database
The application's SQLite database: one JDBC connection, foreign keys on, and the schema in src/main/resources/db/schema.sql applied on open.
Database.RowMapper<T>
Maps the current row of a result set to an object.
DatabaseException
An unchecked wrapper for SQLException, so stores need no checked exceptions.
DatabaseInUseException
Thrown when the database file is already open in another running copy of the app.
DateTimeInput
A date picker and a time box side by side, used wherever a borrow period is entered (the buyer's borrow request and the seller's counter-period).
Deal
An accepted DealRequest and its own lifecycle (SRS class diagram, 0..1 per request).
DealHistorySearch
Deal History filters (SRS UC-1.6 S1): the buyer's finished deals narrowed by a date range, category, seller and keyword.
DealHistorySearch.Criteria
What the buyer filtered by; every field is optional (null or blank means "any").
DealLifecycle
Single source of truth for request, deal and listing status transitions, so the buyer, seller and admin portals all agree on what is allowed.
DealLifecycle.Listener
Told after every successful transition, so a store can save it.
DealRequest
A buyer's request on a listing: a PriceOffer, BorrowRequest or Claim (SRS class diagram).
DealRequestService
Make Deal Request (SRS UC-1.4): a buyer's price offer, borrow request or claim on a live listing.
DealStatus
Lifecycle of an accepted request, from active to its final outcome.
DealStore
Deal requests and deals.
DealType
What the buyer gets from an accepted request.
DummyDataService
The application's data, split into per-area stores and backed by a local SQLite database ("data/marketplace.db").
DurationText
Renders a Duration for people: the largest two non-zero units, largest first.
FavouriteStore
Favourites (Buyer to Listing) and Follows (Buyer to Seller) associations, both many-to-many with no duplicates (SRS class diagram, UC-1.3 S1).
GiveawayListing
A listing whose buyer claims it for free (SRS UC-1.4).
LendingRules
The one place the lending-duration and borrow-period rules live, so a Lend Listing and the deal lifecycle cannot disagree about what a valid duration is.
LendListing
A listing lent for a fixed period (SRS UC-1.4).
Listing
Abstract base for a listing.
ListingDetailDialog
A small read-only preview of one listing.
ListingFormComponent
A standalone, reusable create/edit listing form.
ListingFormState
Pure-Java state behind the create-listing form.
ListingPhotos
Listing photos, shared by the buyer and admin screens so photos look the same everywhere (brief: consistent shared components across the three portals).
ListingReport
A buyer's report on a listing (SRS UC-1.10, UC-3.7).
ListingSearch
The Browse Marketplace rules (SRS UC-1.3): which listings a buyer sees, and the search, filter and sort over them.
ListingSearch.Criteria
What the buyer asked for.
ListingSearch.SortOrder
The three sort orders of SRS UC-1.3 step 3.3.
ListingStatus
The lifecycle status of a listing, from submission to its final state.
ListingStore
Listings, kept in memory and written to the listings and listing_photos tables on every change and loaded back at startup (ListingStore.load(UserStore)).
ListingType
Final discriminator returned by each subclass's getType(); there is deliberately no setter (see ADR-0004).
LoanTimer
Checks borrow due dates on a timer, independently of any screen (SRS UC-1.6 special requirements).
LocalPhotoStorage
Demo photo storage: copies chosen photos into a managed folder under the project root and returns only a project-root-relative path for Listing.photoPaths.
Location
The campus meetup locations offered on listings and seller profiles (SRS Appendix A).
LoginGate
Pure credential-gate decision shared by the Buyer, Seller and Admin login portals.
LoginGate.Outcome
The result of one login attempt; the caller maps it to a message.
MarketplaceApp
HKUST Marketplace - Main Application Entry Point Frontend-only demo / skeleton for student development.
Message
One entry in a ChatThread (ADR-0005).
MessageSearchFilter
Which kinds of Message a chat search returns: every message, only free text, or only Formal Offer cards.
Money
A validated asking price on a Sale listing, always at most two decimal places.
MyDealsService
Manage My Deals (SRS UC-1.6): the buyer answers a seller's counter-offer, returns a borrowed item or marks a purchase or claim complete.
Notification
A notification sent to one account: its text, category, optional link and read state.
NotificationBoardView
Builds the notification board shared by the buyer, seller and admin portals.
NotificationCategory
The 14 notification categories defined in SRS Appendix A.
NotificationRef
Where an OPEN notification should take the user.
NotificationRef.Target
The kind of object an OPEN notification links to.
NotificationStore
Notification board, one list shared by all recipients.
PasswordHasher
The single place in the application that hashes or verifies passwords.
PasswordRule
The password rules from UC-1.1 A3.
PasswordVisibility
Adds a show/hide toggle button beside a PasswordField.
PhotoDraft
A photo the user has chosen in the form but that has not been stored yet.
PhotoStorage
Stores a chosen photo and returns the project-root-relative path that should be written into Listing.photoPaths, of the form photos/<sellerUsername>/<listingId>/<uuid>.<ext>.
PriceOffer
A price offer on a Sale listing.
ProfileService
Manage Profile (SRS UC-1.7): a signed-in buyer or seller changes their full name and, optionally, their password.
RegistrationService
Buyer and seller registration (SRS UC-1.1, UC-2.1): saves the new account and tells every admin about it (step 7, an Account Change notification).
ReportStatus
Moderation state of a listing report (SRS Appendix A).
ReportStore
Listing reports.
RequestStatus
Lifecycle of a deal request from submit to its final outcome.
Review
A buyer's review of one completed deal: a 1-5 star rating, a comment, an optional seller reply and the moderation flags (SRS UC-1.7, UC-2.6, UC-3.6).
ReviewService
Manage Reviews (SRS UC-1.9) and Report Listing (UC-1.10) from the buyer's side.
ReviewStore
Reviews.
SaleListing
A listing sold for a fixed asking price (SRS UC-1.4).
SceneManager
Central navigation helper.
Seller
Seller account: posts Sale, Lend and Giveaway listings and replies to reviews.
SellerDashboardController
Seller dashboard controller: builds the listings, requests, stats, reviews, notifications and profile screens in one content pane.
SellerLoginController
Handles the seller login form and opens the seller dashboard.
SellerProfileService
A seller's public profile (brief 1.10, SRS UC-1.9 postconditions): who they are, their average rating and reviews, and their listings a buyer can act on.
SellerProfileService.SellerProfile
What a seller's profile page shows.
SellerRegisterController
Handles the seller registration form, including the UC-1.1 password rules.
SellerRequestsController
Handles the standalone seller requests screen (offers and borrow requests per listing).
SellerReviewService
Seller-only actions on the reviews of their own listings.
SellerService
Seller-only actions on the seller's own listings.
SellerStats
Immutable snapshot of a seller's activity, derived on demand from the stores and never persisted.

One listing's activity.
SellerStats.Totals
The headline numbers on the stats page.
SellerStatsService
Derives a seller's activity figures on demand from the stores.
SessionManager
Simple session holder for the currently logged-in user.
User
Abstract base for every marketplace account.
UserRole
The three account roles: each account holds exactly one (SRS Appendix B).
UserStore
Accounts, keyed by lower-case username.
WelcomeController
Landing screen where the visitor picks the Buyer, Seller or Admin portal.
